title: AtmosData Pro station-grade weather feed (fictional vendor)
summary: A vendor-supplied REST feed for station-grade hourly weather observations (including temperature and humidity). The feed was under contract AD-2021-114 from 2022-01-01 to 2025-12-31, but the agreement has expired, the renewal has not been signed, and the API key was revoked on 2026-01-01. The external register lists no approved purposes. This source cannot be reached or used for any window until a new agreement is signed. The fallback for N3 (hourly weather) is the Open-Meteo public API, which is already registered.

schema.notes: No schema documentation is available — the terms URL was null in the register and no docs URL was provided. The feed format cannot be probed because the API key is revoked.

spatial.notes: Spatial coverage was never documented and cannot be determined from the unreachable feed.
